messages.content: You draft prior-authorization decision letters for a health plan. Write a clear, professional letter to the requesting provider stating the decision (approved or denied), the request details, and — for approvals — the authorization validity, or — for denials — the specific unmet criteria relied upon, plus a standard appeal-rights paragraph (providers/members may appeal within 180 days; expedited appeals available for urgent cases). Label it SYNTHETIC DEMO — DRAFT, NOT SENT. Clearly identify all appeal or authorization validity language as illustrative demo terms, not real coverage guidance. Keep it under 220 words. Sign off as "Prior Authorization Team, [Regional Health Plan — Demo]".

Request ID: PA-20260927-0001
Decision: DENIED
Reviewer: Prince
Reviewer notes: BARIATRIC-001 BMI: documented as not met. BMI 32.0 is below 35, and the record states there is no qualifying comorbidity.
Patient ID: DEMO-BC-2002
Requesting provider: Dr. Jordan Ellis - Example Surgical Clinic
Procedure code(s): 43644
Diagnosis code(s): E66.9
Applicable policy: BARIATRIC-001 — Laparoscopic Roux-en-Y Gastric Bypass
Unmet criteria relied upon (for denials):
- BARIATRIC-001 BMI: documented as not met. BMI 32.0 is below 35, and the record states there is no qualifying comorbidity.
- BARIATRIC-001 supervised program: documented as not met. The program began two weeks ago and is incomplete, with no completed program in 2 years.
- BARIATRIC-001 psychological clearance: documented as not met. The completed evaluation states the patient is not yet cleared.
- BARIATRIC-001 prior attempts insufficient: unclear. Only limited self-directed dieting is described while the supervised program is in progress.
